title: Path traversal reported on one download route, present on every path into the uploads folder
measures: Fixes a reported path traversal on GET /files/:name where the same unchecked posix.join(UPLOADS, user input) also sits in the thumbnails route (two inputs), the upload route (a write), and the avatar route (stored: the path is set by PUT /me/avatar and read later). A fix at the reported spot, or in the downloads module only, leaves the secrets readable through the avatar and overwritable through uploads; a startsWith(UPLOADS) check without the trailing slash also lets /srv/app/uploads-old through.
prompt: Security report from a customer: GET https://files.shop.example/files/..%2Fconfig%2Fsecrets.env returns our secrets file. Please fix it.
